HelloStartupBanner.heading: Hello, Free For Brazil Startups.
HelloStartupBanner.subheading: Full customer-support software — omnichannel inbox, AI chatbot, and automation — completely free for early-stage businesses in Brazil under R$ 360,000 in annual revenue. Build your customer experience now; pay only when you've grown.

HelloStartupWhy.heading: Why we built this
HelloStartupWhy.description: Early-stage businesses shouldn't have to choose between good customer support and their runway. Hello Free for Startups gives qualifying Brazil startups the same platform growing companies pay for — at zero cost — so you can deliver professional, multi-channel support from day one. When your business grows past the startup stage, you simply move to a paid plan, keeping all your data and setup.

HelloStartupEligibility.heading: Eligibility — you must meet ALL of the following
HelloStartupEligibility.description: To keep this program focused on genuine early-stage businesses, your business qualifies only if it meets every condition below.

cards.title: Business type
cards.description: You are a registered business in Brazil (with valid CNPJ).

cards.title: Revenue cap
cards.description: Your annual revenue is below R$ 360,000, as evidenced by your financial statements.

cards.title: Mandatory documentation
cards.description: Valid audited or filed financial statements (Balanço Patrimonial) for the most recent financial year, proof of business registration (CNPJ), and a signed self-declaration of annual revenue.

cards.title: One account per business
cards.description: Only one free Startup account is permitted per registered entity. Creating multiple accounts or splitting your business to stay within limits will disqualify you.

HelloStartupPlan.heading: What you get — free
HelloStartupPlan.subheading: The Free Startup Plan gives you full access to Hello — capped at the limits below. Stay within them and you pay nothing.
HelloStartupPlan.action_badge: Usage limits of the free tier
HelloStartupPlan.notice: Cross any of these caps and you'll simply be invited to upgrade to a paid plan — your account and data continue uninterrupted.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Complete the form and upload your financial statement and registration proof.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Our team verifies your documents and eligibility, typically within a few business days.

steps.title: Activation
steps.description: Once approved, your free Startup account is switched on.

steps.title: Annual review
steps.description: We re-confirm eligibility each year. If you've crossed R$ 360,000 or exceeded usage limits, we'll help you transition smoothly to a paid plan.

HelloStartupGrow.heading: When you grow, you keep everything
HelloStartupGrow.description: Crossing R$ 360,000 is a good problem. When you do, your data, conversations, and setup stay exactly as they are — you just move to a paid Hello plan. No migration, no disruption.

items.question: Is it genuinely free?
items.answer: Yes — within the usage limits above, for as long as you remain eligible.

items.question: Why do you need financial documents?
items.answer: To fairly and consistently verify that your revenue is below R$ 360,000. It is a mandatory requirement of this program.

items.question: What if I exceed the ticket or agent limit?
items.answer: You'll be prompted to upgrade to a paid plan; your account and data continue uninterrupted.

items.question: What happens at annual review if I've grown?
items.answer: You transition to a paid plan — nothing is lost.

items.question: Can access be withdrawn?
items.answer: Yes, if eligibility is no longer met or the Terms are breached.
